title: Durable Work Is Not Execution Authority
title_zh: 持久工作不等于执行权
coreProposition: A durable work item can remain safely preserved while execution permission is deliberately withheld until a separate authorization boundary is crossed.
uniqueVisualMetaphor: A sealed physical work capsule resting safely behind a distinct raised mechanical gate, with an open path visible beyond it but no motion yet.
primarySubject: One tangible metal-and-glass work capsule with a clearly separate physical gate
composition: Landscape 16:9, capsule dominant in foreground-left, gate as a strong vertical boundary at center, calm open path receding into background; low information density and cinematic depth.
palette: Deep graphite, cool steel, restrained cyan light, small warm amber accent at the gate edge
style: Serious editorial technology photography, physically credible materials, cinematic lighting, strong focal hierarchy
